race.title: Visit racingtv.com Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
race.verdict: This provides a good opportunity for KEFIR D'OUDAIRIES to make a winning handicap debut on the back of his facile win in a small-field novice at Warwick 2 weeks ago. Bertie's Ballet is respected with the longer trip likely to suit, with El Gavilan also a potential factor in reapplied headgear. KEFIR D'OUDAIRIES (FR) BERTIE'S BALLET EL GAVILAN (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Kefir D'oudairies (6/4), El Gavilan (11/4), Bertie's Ballet (4/1), Old Gregorian (7/1), Diamond Koda (14/1), Kel Raffles (25/1), Kaikoura (33/1), Dontelimurnamepike (33/1), Norah's Legacy (33/1), Fine Thing (50/1)
